==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I attained lucidity by inducing sleep paralysis. The Death Staff rooted itself into the Village King's head and corrupted him. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Village King resembles a giant, wooden, elf man who wears a green robe with a white fur collar. But when the Death Staff roots itself into his head, a white skull mask forms over his face and he becomes shrouded in a purple flamelike aura. The Death Staff resembles a wooden staff that radiates with purple energy. When rooted into the Village King's head it resembles a wooden horn radiating purple energy. The Death Staff clearly is alive and seems to be able to bind to and possess other beings made of wood.)
Using geomancy I manipulated the minerals inside of the Death Staff, ripping it off the Village King's head.
The Village King now understands the corruptive nature of the Death Staff and agrees that it should be hidden.
